The new renderer is faster on lower-end graphics, such as Intel laptops, with no change to the picture.
Shaders are now prepared during loading, so levels no longer hitch while you play.
Street decals (scorch marks and trash) no longer flicker or vanish on some graphics cards.
New "Gyro rest deadband" setting in Controls, and mouse sensitivity can now go down to 0.05 for finer gyro aiming.
